entities.name: Francisco Antonio de Agurto, Marquis of Gastañaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Antonio de Agurto y Salcedo Medrano Zúñiga, 1st Marquess of Gastañaga was a Spanish nobleman, Knight of the Order of Alcantara, of His Majesty's Supreme War Council, General Field Marshal of the Netherlands, Governor and Captain General of the Spanish Netherlands and Viceroy of Catalonia, of Basque origin. Francisco Antonio was the son of Don Antonio de Agurto y Alava and Catalina de Salcedo y Medrano, daughter of Iñigo López de Salcedo Camargo and María Melchora de Medrano Zúñiga y Vallejo.
